variable_stack.HK: Most "custom" prints are posters in disguise.
What do you give someone who has everything?
There's a reason this gift never gets returned.
Gallery-grade prints of 3,000+ cities. Made to order.
Last year I gave my parents a gift card. Never again.
Three months in the new place. Still bare walls.
The gift they'll still talk about next year.
The block he grew up on. Framed on his wall now.
Look closer. Those are real street names.
Your city, the way you remember it.
Some gifts get forgotten by Monday.
Every city you've loved, framed on one wall.
"It's the city of our first trip together."
When did a gift last earn a spot on the wall?
Generic gifts don't survive the year. Walls do.

active_hypotheses: Row A (TN_Assertive) isolates on quality/craft-led assertive tone across all four ICPs.
Row B (PR_Testimonial) isolates on unattributed customer-quote proof across all four ICPs.
Row C (HP_ForgettableGift) isolates on the forgettable/generic-gift pain point across all four ICPs.
Row D (CTA_ClaimOffer) isolates on offer-as-closer, never as hook, across all four ICPs.
Main diagonal (C1A/C2B/C3C/C4D) and counter diagonal (C1D/C2C/C3B/C4A) are the highest-confidence isolation read once live.
evidence_notes: No live performance data exists yet — every evidence_grade above is produced_pre-launch, not a proven winner or failed pattern. Do not treat anything in creative_log as a performance signal until spend and conversion data comes back through metrix-mst-test-engine.
